name: ptyper2-par1-scala
description: The parallel driver on one worker against the serial compile of the same build, on the `scala` corpus (library, reflect, compiler) stopped after the typer, paired within each fork: a check of the claim that one-thread parallel is at or below serial on large corpora. `aa` is `spike` again. xctrace counts the benchmark thread only, so a `-Yparallel-typer` variant's counters miss its worker thread: compare those by time.

variantDescriptions.spike: the parallel typer spike at `3c72e64ddf`, without `-Yparallel-typer`
variantDescriptions.aa: the first variant's build again, in its own class loader: the A/A
variantDescriptions.fix: `spike` plus the overhead fixes (branch `ptyper-overhead-fixes` at `be52f84d1e`), without the flag
